heading: Where your explanations differ

headings.settle: What would tell your explanations apart

empty: Once two of you have revealed different figures for the same card, they show here side by side, with what each does to the chances.

differences.label: Time to first signed contract for the paid diagnostic
differences.goal_label: Generate revenue as quickly as possible
differences.status_text: With Priya's figure, no option is clearly most likely to achieve 'Generate revenue as quickly as possible'; with Tom's figure, 'Test a fixed-scope paid enterprise diagnostic before offering broader consulting' is the option most likely to achieve 'Generate revenue as quickly as possible'. Which option is most likely in this model turns on this difference. The chance that 'Test a fixed-scope paid enterprise diagnostic before offering broader consulting' achieves 'Generate revenue as quickly as possible' is under 1% with Priya's figure and about 68% with Tom's figure.

settle.text: Olumi's run already names 'Time to first signed contract for the paid diagnostic' as a figure where better information could change which option is most likely to achieve 'Generate revenue as quickly as possible'.

Evidence tells your figures apart only if it is more likely under one than the other: for example a recorded figure for 'Time to first signed contract for the paid diagnostic' from a past period or a comparable case, checked against each of yours. Evidence that fits both does not settle it.

options.label: Add consulting services to the AI startup

withheld.reason: The chance that 'Add consulting services to the AI startup' meets 'Create additional opportunities to sell the product' is not worked out: the measure, 'Additional qualified enterprise product sales opportunities from completed service engagements', is worked out from 'Enterprise service engagements completed within the exploration window' and 'Additional qualified enterprise opportunities per completed engagement', and does not count 'Time from starting the offer to the first signed customer contract', which 'Add consulting services to the AI startup' also changes; left out of the measure: The opportunity count covers service-generated product opportunities, not opportunities from direct product selling, eventual wins, sales value, opportunities arising before service completion, or product opportunities lost through displaced selling effort. To compare it, add to the model how 'Time from starting the offer to the first signed customer contract' changes 'Additional qualified enterprise product sales opportunities from completed service engagements', or measure 'Create additional opportunities to sell the product' so it counts this route too.
